title: Independent new app repo and database
acceptance: Only reviewed owned source is copied into a separate repo/app and fresh Supabase project/database/auth/storage; never shared schema/worktree; no old secrets or bindings; fail-before-call identity guards; original FireAfter status/hashes preserved

title: Coherent incident onboarding
acceptance: Fresh session deliberately selects a live or replay incident and preserves exact incident context across all screens

title: Explicit evidence mode
acceptance: Live/replay/synthetic labels persist through documents; plans; history; exports and traces; no silent mode substitution

title: Temporal coverage and missingness
acceptance: Unknown publication/effective times remain unknown; expired/missing measured inputs cannot become low risk or current evidence

title: Immutable document versions
acceptance: Meaningful content/metadata updates create immutable versions; same-content checks create retrieval events without false material updates

title: Functional Tavily retrieval
acceptance: Real authorized runtime Search/Extract obtains source evidence with destination validation; failures stay visible

title: Functional NVIDIA inference on Nebius
acceptance: Real authorized Nemotron runtime call through Token Factory produces typed interpretation with exact model/config usage evidence

title: Supported applicable claims
acceptance: Every promoted claim has valid version/span and scope/time applicability; critical semantic support checked; ambiguity held for review

title: Material change and conflict handling
acceptance: Substantive and benign updates distinguished; withdrawn/conflicting issuers preserved and flagged instead of arbitrary override

title: Evidence-to-plan dependencies
acceptance: Each affected proposal item references immutable relevant claims/source versions and unaffected items remain explainably unaffected

title: Current evidence at approval
acceptance: Atomic generation/version/clock/constraint fence rejects stale or unresolved dependency approval including concurrent updates

title: Feasible inspection proposals
acceptance: Deterministic crew/capability/time-window constraints checked; missing estimates or infeasibility cannot become invented feasibility

title: Human decisions and receipts
acceptance: Current exact role checked; incident_commander accepts/rejects; modify creates reviewed draft; same command replays historical receipt; conflicting payload rejects

title: Immutable history and correction
acceptance: Decision-time evidence retained and accessible under scope; later changes create new revisions without rewriting prior approvals

title: Complete briefing export
acceptance: Serialize one authorized persisted revision with source/mode/limits/redaction; artifact-created receipt separate from client byte/hash verification; no disk-save claim

title: Durable bounded recovery
acceptance: Jobs resume original scoped identity/deadline/budget under fencing; ambiguous decision result reconciles without duplicate mutation

title: Scoped identity and disclosure
acceptance: Cross-org/cross-incident access and public facility detail disclosure denied in every new route; keys server-only

title: Reliable unrestricted judge journey
acceptance: Dedicated new-target judge access completes full submitted workflow free without waitlist/payment/manual approval through judging end; private credentials in testing instructions; actual sponsor evidence

title: Reproducible evaluation and usefulness
acceptance: Frozen reviewed corpus; raw metric denominators; named reviewer scope and failures; actual practitioner results; optional offline learning status explicit; comparison only if authorized; no automatic promotion

title: Accessible rendered interaction
acceptance: Keyboard and narrow-screen flow; readable focus/errors/touch controls; no color-only status; rendered states inspected

title: Budget observability and limits
acceptance: Cumulative request/token/byte/spend ceilings survive retries; redacted traces preserve run/config and failure evidence

title: Submission and rules evidence
acceptance: All numbered rules mapped to evidence/owner; entrant eligibility support history and rights reviewed; compatible detected license/setup; significant updates; English public video under three minutes; final links feedback actual confirmation and frozen accessible submission

title: Scoped adaptive adversarial regression
acceptance: Authorized sandbox static seeds plus bounded adaptive trajectories test app controls with independent oracles; safe reproducible evidence; any Critical or unresolved High blocks candidate

title: Implementable supported release bounds
acceptance: Full bounded journey for one qualified incident; five registered text documents; ten tasks/two crews/eight-hour shift; explicit capacity rejection; effort checkpoint and extension freeze

title: Safe reviewer feedback seed
acceptance: Optional typed correction binds original immutable claim/source and review receipt; server actor bounded text idempotency; distinct owner permission gates offline use; no public/private pooling or automatic policy/model promotion; full review works without learning permission
